games.title: Lemmings and Oh No! More Lemmings
games.blurb: Guide the lemmings to the exit: 120 levels of Lemmings and 100 of Oh No! More Lemmings, from the original DOS data.
games.licence: Engine: Lemmings.ts fork (MIT) with the DOSBox DBOPL music emulator (GPL-2.0-or-later). Game data: original DOS files, full accounts only.

games.title: Prince of Persia
games.blurb: The original DOS adventure on the SDLPoP engine, with touch controls and local quicksaves.
games.licence: SDLPoP browser fork: GPL-3.0-or-later, Dávid Nagy and contributors. Original game data: private, approved full accounts only.

games.title: Heroes of Might and Magic II Gold
games.blurb: The Succession Wars and The Price of Loyalty on the fheroes2 browser engine, with touch and local saves.
games.licence: fheroes2: GPL-2.0-or-later. Original Heroes II Gold data: private, approved full accounts only.

games.title: Commander Keen
games.blurb: Keen 1 to 6 and Keen Dreams on the Commander Genius engine, with touch controls and quick saves.
games.licence: Engine: Commander Genius fork (GPL-2.0). Game data: original DOS files; episodes 2, 3 and 5 are bought games, so the game files load for full accounts only.

games.title: Adventure Classics (ScummVM)
games.developer: Lucasfilm Games / LucasArts, Cyan, Revolution Software, Interactive Binary Illusions, Adept Software
games.blurb: The Secret of Monkey Island, Monkey Island 2, Myst, Beneath a Steel Sky, Flight of the Amazon Queen, Lure of the Temptress and God of Thunder on ScummVM, with tap-to-click touch controls and saves.
games.licence: Engine: ScummVM (GPL-3.0-or-later), our web build with its source linked from the page. Game data: original files (Monkey Island 1-2, Myst and God of Thunder are bought or unverified games; Beneath a Steel Sky, Flight of the Amazon Queen and Lure are freeware), full accounts only.

games.title: The Incredible Machine
games.developer: Jeff Tunnell Productions / Dynamix; published by Sierra On-Line
games.blurb: Build Rube Goldberg machines from bowling balls, conveyor belts and mouse motors. Puzzles 1-21 and bonus puzzle 28 are verified with the original art and palette.
games.licence: Recreation code: ours. Game data: original DOS files, full accounts only.

games.title: Jazz Jackrabbit
games.blurb: Episode 1, Turtle Terror (the shareware release): Diamondus, Tubelectric and Medivo on the OpenJazz engine, with touch controls and saved games.
games.licence: Engine: OpenJazz fork (GPL-2.0-or-later), source linked from the page. Game data: the Epic MegaGames shareware v1.1 release, whose LICENSE.DOC lets online services distribute it as long as no files are altered or removed; all files kept.

games.title: Tyrian 2000
games.developer: Eclipse Software; published by XSIV Games
games.blurb: The vertical shoot-'em-up on the OpenTyrian2000 engine: drag to fly on touch screens, the full story, arcade and two-player modes, and your saved games kept.
games.licence: Engine: OpenTyrian2000 fork (GPL-2.0-or-later). Game data: the original Tyrian 2000 files, served to approved accounts.

games.title: Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure
games.developer: Todd Replogle and Stephen Hornback; published by Apogee
games.blurb: Cosmo's rescue of his parents on the Forbidden Planet, on the cosmo-engine reconstruction, with touch controls and the game's own nine save slots.
games.licence: Engine: cosmo-engine fork (GPL-2.0-or-later). Game data: Apogee's shareware episode 1 v1.20, whose VENDOR.DOC lets everyone copy and pass it around unchanged; it is served complete.
